quote: This question was later formally conjectured by C. Gordon (see Problem 1.78). In 1990, Berge pointed out a 'mechanism' of known lens space surgery involving doubly-primitive knots in genus 2 Heegaard surfaces, and he gave a conjecturally complete list of such knots.
note: The Berge conjecture was formally conjectured by Cameron Gordon, citing Problem 1.78, circa 1990. The original observations and list of knots came from John Berge's work around 1990 (unpublished manuscript 'Some knots with surgeries yielding lens spaces'). Gordon's formal conjecture followed from Berge's observations.
